rv.q: If this is a slightly scrappy drama, it bewitches with hope, romance and heart.
The play’s ending is a perfect balance of joy and gloom, all marvelously managed in a great production.
The script feels slightly unfocused, prone to overreaching.

cn.t: A heartfelt love story that tackles homophobic persecution and asylum issues with ingenuity, though critics note the 80-minute runtime leaves themes underexplored and the script occasionally unfocused.
